title: The sphere's count is in PPADS: a degree-3 Sherali-Adams refutation with coefficients +-1
subject: Where the knot sphere's count sits among proof systems and TFNP classes
conclusion: The lines' clause falsifiers minus the faces' monochromatic conjunctions sum to exactly 1, a degree-3 Sherali-Adams refutation with 4n - 8 terms and coefficients +-1, so by the unary Sherali-Adams characterization of PPADS^dt (Goos, Hollender, Jain, Maystre, Pires, Robere, Tao) finding a violated line is in PPADS^dt, between one-sided 2D Sperner and PPADS. Cutting-planes and XOR-reasoning solvers do no better than CDCL on it, and whether short cutting-planes or Res(xor) proofs exist is open.
